title: Procurement
description: Purchase orders commit spend with vendors. Issuing a PO creates a committed cost — not an expense.
materialsDescription: Reusable material items for purchase order lines.

orders.title: No purchase orders yet
orders.body: Create a draft PO with line items, then issue it to open a committed cost. Expenses are recorded separately when money is spent.

rfqs.title: No RFQs yet
rfqs.body: Request quotes from vendors, compare totals, then create a purchase order from an accepted quote.

materials.title: No materials yet
materials.body: Add catalog items so purchase order lines can reference them.

vendorsRequired.title: Add a vendor first
vendorsRequired.body: Purchase orders need a vendor. Create one, then come back to start a PO.

detail.title: Purchase order
detail.description: Committed spend with a vendor. Attach supporting documents without treating this as an expense.

issue.hint: Issues the PO and opens a committed cost. Does not create an expense.

create.title: New purchase order
create.description: Draft a PO with at least one line. Issue later to commit the amount.

material.detailDescription: Catalog identity and vendor-specific unit prices. Default price is a planning reference, not an expense.

rfq.title: RFQs
rfq.description: Request quotes from suppliers, compare side-by-side, then create a purchase order.
rfq.detailDescription: Lines, supplier quotes, and comparison. Creating a PO from a quote commits spend — it is not an expense.
rfq.comparisonHint: Sorted by comparable total (lowest first) within each currency.
rfq.poCommittedHint: Accepting a quote creates a draft purchase order. Issuing that PO opens a committed cost — it is not an expense.

create.title: New RFQ
create.description: Describe what you need. Add supplier quotes after creating the RFQ.

quote.emptyComparison: Add quotes to compare vendor totals.
quote.createPoHint: Accepts the quote if needed and creates a draft purchase order. Issue later to open committed cost — not an expense.

errors.notDraft: Only draft purchase orders can be issued.
errors.committedRequired: Issuing a purchase order must create a committed cost.
errors.expenseForbidden: Issuing a purchase order must not create an expense.
errors.committedMismatch: Committed amount must equal the sum of line totals.
errors.currencyMismatch: All purchase order lines must use the PO currency.
errors.linesRequired: Add at least one line with a description and amounts.
errors.rfqLinesRequired: Add at least one RFQ line with a description.
errors.quoteNotAccepted: Only accepted supplier quotes can become purchase orders.
errors.quoteLinesRequired: Accepted quote must have at least one line.
errors.quoteTotalMismatch: Quote total must equal the sum of line totals.

vendorPrice.title: Vendor prices
vendorPrice.description: Optional per-vendor unit prices with an effective date. Not inventory stock and not an expense posting.
vendorPrice.emptyBody: Add a vendor-specific unit price when a supplier quote differs from the catalog default.
vendorPrice.needVendor: Add an active vendor before recording vendor-specific prices.
